name: CausalNHANES
description: Replication package for the CausalNHANES benchmark: source code, scenario configurations, evaluation scripts, all model outputs (formal experiment, negative-control repeat runs x5, English-prompt comparison, temperature sensitivity, sampling-variance analysis), scoring results, anchor-validation audits, and API version logs. Prepared for anonymous peer review; model and provider identifiers are pseudonymized (e.g., llm-k26) and will be de-anonymized upon acceptance. NHANES raw data are not redistributed (see README for CDC download instructions). All API keys removed.
